title: ACCOUNT_MERGE fails with ACCOUNT_MERGE_IMMUTABLE_SET
pattern: A transaction whose ACCOUNT_MERGE operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (immutable_set). An issuer with AUTH_IMMUTABLE can never be merged.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
